title: The assistant refuses password resets after the security fix
scenario: After a pen-test fix, Larkspur's self-service assistant answers 'I can't help with that here' to password-reset requests and self-service collapses from 85% to under 10%. The thread blames the new prompt line or wants the guardrail rolled back; security will not reopen the finding. You get model invocation logs with guardrail traces, metrics, the release note and the guardrail config.
task: Prove from invocation logs and config why legitimate requests are blocked; rule out the prompt
Narrow the denied topics so self-service works and every attack stays blocked
Keep prompt-attack and password protections and the CreateGuardrail limits
Point the Lambda at a new guardrail version
acceptance: All legit eval cases allowed and all attacks blocked, including a held-out set
Topics narrowed, not deleted; other protections intact
New guardrail version pinned; ANONYMIZE keeps the conversation
Root cause with evidence in ANSWER.md
